title: AssetPolicy
description: Schema for config/asset_policy.json. Defines provenance/licensing rules (where assets may come from, what license metadata is required) and usage/edit protection rules (what may be done to each asset type).

version.description: Policy version string (semver recommended). Increment when rules change.

approved_source_domains.description: Hostnames from which assets may be sourced. Checked against the asset's source URL domain. Subdomains are included implicitly.

forbidden_url_patterns.description: Regex patterns matched against a source URL. A match means the asset may not be used. Patterns are evaluated case-insensitively.

required_license_fields.description: Field names that must be present on an asset's license record when require_license is true for that asset type.

require_alt_text.description: If true, every asset attached to a post must carry a non-empty alt_text value.

usage_policies.description: Per-asset-type usage and edit rules. Keys are asset type slugs (e.g. 'logo', 'stock_photo'). Any key is valid; conventional types are defined in the spec.

_notes.description: Free-text notes, caveats, or TODO items for this policy file.

UsagePolicy.title: UsagePolicy
UsagePolicy.description: Edit and usage rules for a single asset type.

edit_rule.description: Permitted modification level. 'locked' = no changes at all; 'resizable_only' = dimensions only; 'croppable_only' = crop only; 'editable' = any edit allowed; 'reference_only' = display/reference use, not for production publishing.

require_license.description: If true, an asset of this type must have a license record with all required_license_fields populated before use.

require_attribution.description: If true, the asset's attribution string must be present and must appear in published content.

allowed_contexts.description: Publishing contexts where this asset type may be used. Conventional values: 'social_post', 'website', 'email', 'blog', 'press'.

_notes.description: Free-text notes for this specific asset type policy.
